records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.load_cellpose_model#2
records.source: ON A CPU THE WEIGHTS ARE LOADED IN FLOAT32. Cellpose-SAM loads them in bfloat16 by default, and a processor without native bfloat16 arithmetic runs every tile through a slow emulation of it: measured on an AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, one 256 px tile took 162-197 s in bfloat16 and 31-46 s in float32, alternating, under the same load. A whole field is a hundred such tiles, so this is the difference between most of an hour and most of a day. On a GPU nothing changes: :func:`spacr.accelerator.cellpose_kwargs` decides there, as it does for the pipeline.
records.context: On a CPU the weights are loaded in float32. Cellpose-SAM loads them in bfloat16 by default, and a processor without native bfloat16 arithmetic runs every tile through a slow emulation of it: measured on an AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, one 256 px tile took 162-197 s in bfloat16 and 31-46 s in float32, alternating, under the same load. A whole microscope field of view is a hundred such tiles, so this is the difference between most of an hour and most of a day. On a GPU nothing changes: :func:`spacr.accelerator.cellpose_kwargs` decides there, as it does for the workflow.
records.translation: CPU 에서는 가중치를 FLOAT32 로 로드합니다. Cellpose-SAM 은 기본적으로 bfloat16 으로 로드하는데, 네이티브 bfloat16 연산이 없는 프로세서는 모든 타일을 느린 에뮬레이션으로 처리합니다. AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 에서 같은 부하로 번갈아 측정한 결과, 256 px 타일 하나에 bfloat16 은 162-197 s, float32 는 31-46 s 가 걸렸습니다. 현미경 시야 전체는 그런 타일이 백 개이므로, 이는 한 시간 가까이와 하루 가까이의 차이입니다. GPU 에서는 아무것도 바뀌지 않습니다. 워크플로에서와 마찬가지로 :func:`spacr.accelerator.cellpose_kwargs` 가 결정합니다.
